I personally don't think the fact that we haven't had a KH4 re-reveal yet means the game won't be out in 2026. I have a feeling they'll keep the KH4 marketing cycle a bit more compact than usual (like maybe 9 months or so) But these business plans on the other hand definitely do paint a picture that KH4 might really be a 2027 title after all... So we're really going for a 7-8 year dev cycle, huh? A 2027 release also makes me unconvinced we'd hear anything at the Game Awards. The next trailer's probably more likely to just appear one day on social media, or as part of a PlayStation State of Play, or maybe at Summer Games Fest 2026 (if the game is indeed releasing in 2027). I'm not gonna be bullish enough to say that it's definitely not gonna be at the Game Awards (unlike what my stance on Gamescom and TGS was), but a fair word of caution for anyone reading this: Don't go into TGA expecting a KH4 re-reveal. You're setting yourself up for disappointment. Again.
